2. **Communicate proactively** with CUST-001 (urgent order), as their Feb 12 deadline is the tightest.
3. **Prioritize allocation** of the 8 units to ORD-007 (urgent) first, then partial fulfillment for ORD-028/ORD-009 only if more stock arrives in time (PROD-001 shelf life is only 7 days — timing matters).
